title: Fix the Non‑semantic Page
description: Take a div‑heavy HTML snippet and rewrite it with proper semantic elements.
problemStatement:
## Convert Div‑Soup to Semantic HTML Below is an inaccessible, div‑based structure. Rewrite it using proper semantic elements (header, nav, main, section, h1‑h3, ul, etc.). Add appropriate ARIA if needed only after using native elements. ```html
Home
About
Welcome to Our Site
We provide amazing services.
Our Services
Design
Development
© 2025
``` Your version must be fully keyboard and screen reader accessible, and use valid HTML.
hints: Use `<a>` for navigation links (they lead to other pages).
Convert section titles to proper heading levels.
expectedOutput: Semantic HTML code that fulfills the same visual layout but is accessible.
solutionCode:
• Home
  • About

Welcome to Our Site

We provide amazing services.

Our Services

  • Design
  • Development

© 2025
